claims.content: An emergency condition exists that requires search and rescue efforts.
The System Operator has additional or more current information on a previously reported emergency point, or the unit with Reporting Responsibility (R²) is declared inactive.

The System Operator determines that an emergency condition exists requiring search and rescue efforts, or acquires additional/current information on a previously reported emergency point, or the unit with Reporting Responsibility (R²) is declared inactive.

trigger.raw_text: The System Operator determines that an emergency condition exists requiring search and rescue efforts, or acquires additional/current information on a previously reported emergency point, or the unit with Reporting Responsibility (R²) is declared inactive.

claims.content: If the System Operator attempts to change a reference or emergency point to any other type of surveillance entity (i.e., using the Reference TN used to identify the point for another type of entity), the action is illegal and must be rejected.

If the System Operator attempts to change the Point Type and/or Point Amplification value of a reference point while retaining the same Reference TN, the action is illegal and must be rejected, unless changing a Point Amplification value of No Statement to a non-No Statement value.
A J3.1 Emergency Point message is transmitted to report the existence of an emergency condition that requires search and rescue efforts.
The emergency point has a TN, Reference different from the TN, Previously Reported associated with it.
If the emergency point was initiated for a previously reported track, the J3.1 message contains the IFF/SIF modes and codes of that track.
The latest JU to report the point assumes Reporting Responsibility (R²) for that point.
